rename.from: ES 7 changes which dates that `date_optional_time` can successfully parse
rename.to: ES 7 changes which dates `date_optional_time` can successfully parse

body: @pgomulka do you have an opinion on this? I see we accepted up to 9 digits in 6.8 (I see from an error message in 6.8 that "year must be in the range [-292275055,292278994]") but maybe the restriction to 5 digits was introduced in 7x on purpose and this should be a documentation issue? I don't know all the background around these decisions I'm afraid.

this might be a bug. As stated in joda 'non strict' `date_optional_time` had year of length 4-9
the `strict_date_optional_time` which is a modified ES version had it changed to year of lenght 4-4
I was about to fix this https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/54260 but I forgot about this PR.
I will try to update the linked PR with the fix for the `date_optional_time` as well

issue.title: Change year max digits for strict_date_optional_time and date_optional_time

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
We changed the default joda behaviour in `strict_date_optional_time` to
max 4 digits in a year. Java.time implementation should behave the same way.
At the same time `date_optional_time` should have 9digits for year part.

closes #52396
closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/72191
